metadata.method_name: Where in Qwen3 a coding ban lives (iteration 3, internal locus)
metadata.quantisation: fp8_e4m3_w8a8_dynamic(per-output-channel weight scales, per-token activation scales; lm_head/embeddings/norms bf16)

conventions.block: block l = decoder block l (0-based); output = hidden_states[l+1]
conventions.S: [p1, spec_end): first token of 'Task:' .. last user token
conventions.k: generated position k = absolute P+k-1 (token k is the input; predicts k+1)
conventions.crn: slot (task, template, k) -> u_stream(task, template, k), identical in every arm

T2.label: exploratory; not part of the frozen C2d rule

T1.label: exploratory; not part of the frozen C2d rule

T03.label: exploratory; not part of the frozen C2d rule

predictions.P1: ADD at alpha 1 or 2 beats every random control on >= 2/3 of the gated tasks and lands on the named ban's modal survivor.
predictions.P2: SUB raises the banned share by >= 0.3.

demo_subset.why: T2 (weighted shortest path, default Dijkstra) and T03 (k-th smallest, default full sort) are the two tasks where ADD moves behaviour at all; slots k 0-9 are the slots on which every arm, including all 18 random-direction arms, was sampled, so ADD-vs-random tests here equal the full run's
demo_subset.label_format: predict_<arm> = '<mechanism-level algorithm label>|<pass|fail on the task's tests>'; arm names are sanitised ('ADD_a1.0' -> 'ADD_a1p0')
demo_subset.full_run_note: metadata.c2d and metadata.exploratory_random_distribution are full-run values (all 6 tasks; BAN, NEUTRAL, SUB_plain and ADD_a1.0 over slots k 0-19, every other arm k 0-9)

c2d_landing_forecasts.source: predictions/c2d_landings.json (commit #2, written before any ban-condition sample)
c2d_landing_forecasts.rule: best alpha = alpha in {1,2} with the highest avoidance among those with pass rate >= 0.5; ties -> alpha 1
